Expedition is engineered to assist you with twists, turns and so much more. Beneficial on all
sorts of surfaces and in all kinds of weather, AdvanceTrac® with RSC® (Roll Stability Control™)
helps you avoid skidding and fishtailing.1 Dual-stage front airbags, front-seat side airbags and
our Safety Canopy® System, which includes a rollover sensor and 3-row side-curtain airbags,
are all standard equipment. Adults can use MyKey® to help block calls and text messaging
when young drivers take the wheel. And if an airbag deploys, Ford SYNC® with 911 Assist® can
help by placing a call to a 911 operator.2 Strengthen your peace of mind with Expedition.
